cases.prompt:
From these customer interview notes, give me the top complaints, with quotes, so I can decide what to fix first.

<input>
Interview 1 (Dana, weekly client 2 yrs): Cleaners are great but arrival window is a mess. "They said 9 to 11 and showed up at 1:40." Has to text the office to find out. Billing fine.
Interview 2 (Marcus, biweekly 8 months): Missed spots in bathrooms twice. "I'm paying for a deep clean and the shower glass still had spots." Arrival times also vary. Would pay more for same team every time.
Interview 3 (Priya, monthly 3 months): New team every visit. "I have to explain the alarm code and the dog every single time." Likes the online booking.
Interview 4 (Tom, weekly 1 yr): "Nobody tells me when they're running late." Was double-charged once in March, refunded after two calls. Happy with quality.
</input>
